title: 5 Offbeat Hidden Gems in Punjab You Haven't Heard Of
summary: Ditch the crowds and explore these secret locations, pristine lakes, and untouched villages in Punjab.
content: While major sights draw crowds, the true magic of Punjab lies in its off-the-beaten-path locations. In this guide, we take you off the tourist grid to explore serene forests, secret waterfalls, and ancient local temples. We reveal spots like Jallianwala Bagh and Jagatjit Club Kapurthala that have preserved their raw natural beauty and tribal culture, offering perfect retreats for solo backpackers and nature lovers.
